Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

CVD EQUIPMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELLS (STARLINK)

You will work closely with our existing CVD Process Engineering team to ensure world-class equipment performance, reliability, and uptime. While the process team focuses on film properties and cell efficiency, you will be the hardware owner responsible for tool availability, stability, and scaling to support our ambitious goals.

FACILITIES ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)

ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

 MISSION MANAGER 

Based out of one of Rocket Lab sites in North America, Mission Managers work directly with customers from signing of contract through payload integration to launch at either our Auckland, New Zealand or Wallops, Virginia launch site for Rocket Lab’s HASTE program. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with both commercial and government customers as well as frequent domestic and international travel. Prior mission management or mission integration experience required, preferably in support of suborbital and/or hypersonic payloads. 

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO: 

• Management of multiple Rocket Lab customer missions, including technical, programmatic, and financial milestones. 

• Oversee hands-on payload integration activities, including fit checks, dispenser and launch vehicle integration. 

• Lead technical milestone reviews with customers such as mission design or test readiness reviews 

• Assists business development with proposal input, lead generation, and technical sales engineering reviews. 

• Responsible for development and verification of Launch Vehicle to Payload Spacecraft Interface Control Documentation (ICD).

About Charm
 
Our mission is to return the atmosphere to 280 ppm CO₂. We convert excess inedible biomass into carbon-rich bio-oil and inject it into underground storage for permanent carbon removal. At scale, we can use bio-oil to make fossil-free iron.
 
Our carbon removal efforts began in 2020 with initial purchases from customers like Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft. Since then, we’ve scaled to thousands of tons of carbon removal, grown to over a hundred employees, and established three locations in San Francisco, Colorado, and Louisiana.
 
We're expanding our team of ambitious, creative, and hands-on problem solvers. We value psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous learning. We take calculated risks and treat mistakes as opportunities to improve. If you're excited about tackling big challenges, we encourage you to explore our company values.
 
Come help us reverse climate change. Gigatons or bust!
